title: Array of Objects to Matrix
summary: Given an array of JSON objects, build a matrix whose first row is the lexicographically sorted union of all flattened leaf paths joined with dots; subsequent rows give each object's leaf value for each path, or empty string when absent. Arrays contribute numeric path components; null is a leaf.
outputFormat: matrix: header row then one row per object
